      • Important message about viewing the City of Glen Cove City Council Meetings starting from the February 10th 2026 meeting and forward

        • All livestreams and recordings can be viewed from the Glen Cove Meeting and Agenda Public Portal page.
        • On that page select the date of the meeting.
        • After selecting the date of the meeting, to find the livestream or the recording of the meeting, select the tab located on the left called "Meeting Media"
        • The livestream will begin at the time of the scheduled meeting which is at 7:30 pm.
        • If you click on the Meeting Media tab prior to the start of the livestream, you will see the message "There is no video for this Event" -- Once the livestream starts the Video should appear, but you may need to refresh the page.
        • The full recording of the meeting will be available on the same tab, shortly after the conclusion of the meeting.
        • Once you start the meeting, if you click on the Media files tab, the video will be available in a smaller screen, if you wish to follow along with the agenda.
        • Click Here for the Glen Cove Meeting and Agenda Public Portal page.

        To view previously recorded City Council Meetings, prior to February 10th 2026, please click here.

        To download a calendar of all dates for pre-council and city council meetings click here.
